archetypes.name: dyn-progress-fs
archetypes.rationale: fd-anchored active-run progress reads and writes should be reviewed for symlink and TOCTOU escapes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed progress breadcrumb reader and writer for fd-safety regressions. Focus on whether default append and statusline reads require a verified active-run pointer, avoid creating clone state during reads, and fail silent without writing through symlinks. Check that tests cover current-pointer, run-log, clone-dir, and legacy-flat-log edge cases. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
